title: The corner's row of the block inverse: exact rows, a frozen rule, a held-out test
claim: Closed 2026-11-11 (pre-registered in c53bb2861; the training verdict and the predictions committed in 128b2e30d before any entry at side 64 was computed; refereed). The registered target, a closed form for the corner's row of K_n^-1 at every n = 2^m, was not reached: under the frozen criteria the outcome is a partial rule only, for the six entries next to the corners, all known or derivable before registration (rho_(L,0) = 1/(1 + L(s^2)); rho_(R,n-2) = s^(2n-1) rho_(L,0); rho_(L,n-2) = s^n rho_(L,0); rho_(R,0) = s^(n-1) + s^(3n-1) rho_(L,0); rho_(R,1) = rho_(L,n-2); rho_(L,n-3) = rho_(R,0), the last two failing at every side 3, 5 to 7 and 9 to 12), and no rule was found for the other 2(n - 1) - 6 entries; 128b2e30d's 'no pattern' is corrected to this. Proved: Proposition 1, rho_(L,b)(w^2) and rho_(R,b)(w^2) are the walk series from c = (0, 1) to the v contacts (0, 2b + 1) and (N, 2b + 1). Computed exactly at n = 4, 8, 16, 32 and the held-out 64: the exact rows (linear complexity at most n(n - 1)); the irreducible factors of the reduced denominators are exactly the minimal polynomials of the classes a in GF(2n)* with extended Kloosterman sum K(a) != 0, every such class appearing (that only these classes occur follows from the spectrum: the reversed minimal polynomial of A^2 on the v contacts is the product of m_a^(|K(a)|/2) over them at 4 to 32); every reduced denominator is a perfect square; the largest exponent of m_a over the row is 2 ceil(|K(a)|/8), below the spectrum's |K(a)|/2 from |K| = 8; along each wall the n - 1 entries have linear complexity exactly n/2 over GF(2)(s) (Hankel certificate).
failure_conditions: An entry at a side 4 to 64 whose exact rational function differs from the recorded one (each reproduces all 4n^2 walk terms computed in s).

A class a in GF(2n)* with K(a) != 0 at a side 4 to 64 whose minimal polynomial divides no denominator of the row, a factor outside those classes, an odd exponent, or a largest exponent other than 2 ceil(|K(a)|/8).
One of the six corner rules failing at a side 4 to 64, or a wall sequence with a singular n/2 x n/2 Hankel matrix there.
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38), and its walk over GF(2) at the powers of two. The row is a contact-level reading (A45).

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the coordinator's go-ahead for B140 on 2026-11-11; read by an independent referee pass on 2026-11-11, which recomputed every row by another method (the Krylov minimal polynomial of e_c under A^2) and every Kloosterman sum and factorization with its own code; its findings are folded in.
validation.status: proved and computed as stated; the registered target not reached: the frozen outcome is a partial rule only (the six entries next to the corners, known or derivable before registration), no closed form for the rest; status class closed-null
validation.novelty: new as far as found (bounded search 2026-11-11): the corner's walk to the side walls sees every class with K(a) != 0, its denominators are perfect squares and their largest exponents are 2 ceil(|K(a)|/8); that only those classes occur is inherited from the spectrum; not a priority claim
